OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship in Robotics and Control at Lancaster University
HostLancaster University
LocationLancaster, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded, stipend provided, tuition covered
StipendUKRI minimum stipend (approx £21,805 (2026/27 UKRI minimum) per year) plus Home tuition fees.
Application Deadline1 December 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Project Overview

Lancaster University’s School of Engineering, in partnership with United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory (UKNNL), invites applications for a fully funded PhD studentship. The project will develop novel data-driven, robust, and adaptive control methods for human–robot interaction and teleoperation, with direct applications in nuclear robotics, hazardous environment manipulation, and beyond.

Project Details

Teleoperation is a critical enabler for safe and efficient operation in hazardous environments such as nuclear decommissioning. Current industrial solutions suffer from limitations under uncertainty, time delays, and noisy sensing. This PhD will design and experimentally validate a hybrid motion–force control framework that ensures precise end-effector positioning while maintaining robust and adaptive force regulation. Research includes development of nonlinear robust adaptive controllers and disturbance observers, design of bilateral teleoperation schemes, integration of data-driven approaches for force estimation, and experimental validation on industrial robotic platforms at the UKNNL Hot Robotics Facility.

Supervisory Team

  • Dr Allahyar Montazeri (Lead Supervisor, School of Engineering)
  • Professor Plamen Angelov (Co-Supervisor, School of Computing and Communications)

Training and Development

  • Hands-on training with ROS2, MATLAB/Simulink, and CoppeliaSim.
  • Access to robotics laboratories and facilities.
  • Opportunities to engage with national and international conferences.
  • Insight into the nuclear sector through industrial collaboration with UKNNL.

Funding

  • Duration: 4 years (3.5 years EPSRC Doctoral Landscape Award + 0.5 years UKNNL extension).
  • Coverage: UKRI minimum stipend, tuition fees for Home students, and a research training support grant.
  • Additional support for consumables, maintenance, and travel.

Eligibility

  • Open to UK Home students only, due to clearance requirements for UKNNL facilities.
  • Applicants should have (or expect to obtain) a First or Upper Second-Class degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Control, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Strong mathematical and programming skills (MATLAB, Python, or C++) are highly desirable.

Application Process

Applicants should submit:

  • A full CV.
  • A one-page cover letter outlining motivation and suitability.
  • Reference letter from two academics commenting on candidate abilities.

Applications will be considered on a rolling basis until the position is filled, with an expected start date of January 2025.

Closing Date

1st December 2026.

Contact

For informal enquiries, please contact Dr Allahyar Montazeri.

Official Link

https://www.lancaster.ac.uk/scc/study/phd/phd-opportunities/

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About Lancaster University

Lancaster University is a public research university in northwest England. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across science, technology, business, humanities and social sciences. Its research includes computing, communications, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence, while its collegiate community supports interdisciplinary work and partnerships with industry, public organisations and international institutions.

Official website: https://www.lancaster.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 December 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
